home.bioMain: I build and ship AI-powered products — from agentic RAG pipelines to multi-agent orchestration systems. At Yotta Infrastructures, I've delivered enterprise-scale platforms used by thousands. My AI work: Nyaya-Pro (legal RAG assistant with semantic re-ranking and zero-hallucination design), JobPilot AI (CrewAI multi-agent pipeline), and ExamGenie AI — all deployed and live.
home.bioSub: This is where I document shipped AI products, engineering decisions, and what I'm building next.

whoIAm: I'm an AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer at Yotta Infrastructures, building production AI applications alongside enterprise-scale platforms.

My AI work spans agentic RAG systems, multi-agent orchestration with CrewAI, and LLM-powered products using Groq, Google Gemini, and OpenAI APIs. Nyaya-Pro — my flagship project — is a legal RAG assistant grounded in Indian legal corpora with cross-encoder re-ranking and cited responses. JobPilot AI and ExamGenie AI are deployed and actively used.
My frontend depth (Angular, Flutter, Next.js) means I don't just build models — I ship complete AI products end to end.

beliefs.title: User-First Design
beliefs.desc: Great software is invisible. Users shouldn't notice the interface; they should just accomplish their goals effortlessly.

beliefs.title: Scalability & Security
beliefs.desc: Working in the infrastructure space has taught me the importance of building systems that are robust, secure, and ready to grow.

beliefs.title: Build in public, ship fast
beliefs.desc: The best way to learn AI engineering is to deploy it. Every project I build solves a real problem and goes live.

projects.title: Nyaya-Pro AI
projects.subtitle: Agentic Legal RAG Assistant (v2.0)
projects.description: A production-grade, multimodal AI assistant for the Indian Legal System. Features real-time voice mode (Hinglish), vision mode for document analysis, and an advanced RAG pipeline with exact-match boosting.

projects.title: JobPilot AI
projects.subtitle: AI Job Application Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered job application assistant orchestrated with CrewAI. Built using local Ollama models for development and Groq API for high-speed production inference.

projects.title: ExamGenie AI
projects.subtitle: AI Exam Generator
projects.description: A powerful platform that transforms study PDFs into interactive, smart exams with instant feedback and explanations. Built with Angular and powered by Google Gemini.

projects.title: OneYotta Portal
projects.subtitle: Customer-facing platform | Yotta Infrastructures
projects.description: A scalable customer portal for managing data center resources, invoices, and real-time monitoring. Built with Angular 17 and integrated with Keycloak for security.

projects.title: OneYotta App
projects.subtitle: Mobile Application | Yotta Infrastructures
projects.description: A comprehensive Flutter application for OneYotta portal, providing data center management and monitoring on the go for Android and iOS.

projects.title: MyPortal
projects.subtitle: Internal Operations | Yotta Infrastructures
projects.description: An internal dashboard for monitoring server utilization, networking, and storage backup operations. Features real-time data visualization and CCTV integration.

projects.title: Spillo Exim
